# Assessment model

- [Stock Synthesis](https://vlab.noaa.gov/web/stock-synthesis/home) since 2012, NOAA ([Methot and Wetzel, 2013](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0165783612003293))

- Updated to version in 3.30.22 2023


- Age-based assuming a single area, fishery, season and genders combined.


- Benchmark in February 2017 : 
  - Method to estimate the initial population
  - SR relationship (Berverton-Holt with $\sigma_{R}$ = 0.7 and steepness = 0.71)
  - Selectivity-at-age for the spring acoustic survey and the fishery


- Inter-Benchmark in October 2021 to include a recruitment index:
 - Age 0 estimates of the autumn acoustic surveys in 9aCN area (1997-onwards)
 - Abundance index with a power model for catchability
 - Extra SD parameter for all abundance indexes
 - Fine tuning ( $\sigma_{R}$ , recruitment deviations ramp)

# Time series

```{r, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)

# ASSESSMENT this year
  biomass.spaly<- subset(spaly$timeseries, Era=="TIME",c("Yr","Bio_smry"))
  
  linhas<-grep("SSB_\\d",spaly$derived_quants$Label)
  cv.b<-data.frame(cv.b=spaly$derived_quants[linhas,"StdDev"]/spaly$derived_quants[linhas,"Value"])
  cv.b$Yr<-spaly$startyr:(spaly$endyr)
  
  biomass.spaly<-merge(biomass.spaly,cv.b,by="Yr")
  biomass.spaly$hi<-biomass.spaly$Bio_smry+2*biomass.spaly$cv.b*biomass.spaly$Bio_smry
  biomass.spaly$lo<-biomass.spaly$Bio_smry-2*biomass.spaly$cv.b*biomass.spaly$Bio_smry
  
  biomass.spaly<-biomass.spaly[,-3]
  colnames(biomass.spaly)[2]<-"Value"
  biomass.spaly$indicator <- "B1+"
  
  biomass.spaly$run<-rep(ass.yr, nrow(biomass.spaly))
  
  # RECRUITMENT
  
  rec.spaly<- subset(spaly$timeseries, Era=="TIME",c("Yr","Recruit_0"))
  
  linhas<-grep("Recr_\\d",spaly$derived_quants$Label)
  
  cv.r<-data.frame(cv.r=spaly$derived_quants[linhas,"StdDev"]/spaly$derived_quants[linhas,"Value"])
  cv.r$Yr<-spaly$startyr:spaly$endyr
  
  rec.spaly<-merge(rec.spaly,cv.r,by="Yr")
  rec.spaly$hi<-rec.spaly$Recruit_0+2*rec.spaly$cv.r*rec.spaly$Recruit_0
  rec.spaly$lo<-rec.spaly$Recruit_0-2*rec.spaly$cv.r*rec.spaly$Recruit_0
  
  rec.spaly<-rec.spaly[,-3]
  colnames(rec.spaly)[2]<-"Value"
  rec.spaly$indicator <- "Recruits"
  
  rec.spaly$run<-rep(ass.yr, nrow(rec.spaly))
  
  # FISHING MORTALITY 2-5 YEARS
  
  #Assessment 2023
  
  selectivity<-subset(spaly$ageselex[spaly$ageselex$Fleet==1 & spaly$ageselex$Factor=="Asel2" & spaly$ageselex$Yr %in% c(spaly$startyr:(spaly$endyr-1)),c("Yr","0","1","2","3","4","5","6") ])
  
  linhas<-grep("F_\\d",spaly$derived_quants$Label)
  linhas<-linhas[-length(linhas)]
  
  f.apical<-data.frame(f=spaly$derived_quants[linhas,"Value"])
  f.apical$Yr<-spaly$startyr:(spaly$endyr-1)
  
  
  f.apsel<-merge(f.apical,selectivity,all.x = T,by="Yr")
  
  
  f<-f.apsel$f*f.apsel[,c("0","1","2","3","4","5","6")]
  f$Yr<-f.apsel$Yr
  
  refF<-apply(f[,c("2","3","4","5")],1,mean)
  
  f.spaly<-data.frame(Yr=f$Yr,Value=refF)
  
  cv.f<-data.frame(cv.f=spaly$derived_quants[linhas,"StdDev"]/spaly$derived_quants[linhas,"Value"])
  cv.f$Yr<-spaly$startyr:(spaly$endyr-1)
  
  f.spaly<-merge(f.spaly,cv.f,by="Yr")
  f.spaly$hi<-f.spaly$Value+2*f.spaly$cv.f*f.spaly$Value
  f.spaly$lo<-f.spaly$Value-2*f.spaly$cv.f*f.spaly$Value
  f.spaly$run<-rep(ass.yr, nrow(f.spaly))
  f.spaly<-f.spaly[,-3]
  f.spaly$indicator <- "Fbar[2-5]"
  
  rr <- bind_rows(biomass.spaly,rec.spaly,f.spaly)
  
```
$B1^{+}$ variation of **`r  round((biomass.spaly$Value[biomass.spaly$Yr==ass.yr] - biomass.spaly$Value[biomass.spaly$Yr==last.yr])/biomass.spaly$Value[biomass.spaly$Yr==last.yr]*100,1)`%**,  $F_{bar[2-5]}$ variation of **`r  round((f.spaly$Value[f.spaly$Yr==last.yr] - f.spaly$Value[f.spaly$Yr==(last.yr-1)])/f.spaly$Value[f.spaly$Yr==(last.yr-1)]*100,0)`%**,  **Recruits** variation of **`r  round((rec.spaly$Value[rec.spaly$Yr==ass.yr] - rec.spaly$Value[rec.spaly$Yr==last.yr])/rec.spaly$Value[rec.spaly$Yr==last.yr]*100,0)`%**

# Retrospective Analysis

- Mohn's rho values for B1+ the Rule of thumb for significant retrospective pattern by 0.01:

 -- Short-lived stocks: Mohn's rho higher than 0.3 or lower than -0.22 [(Hurtado-Ferro et al., 2015](https://academic.oup.com/icesjms/article/72/1/99/2804338)


- Retrospective pattern improved when compared to last year

# SHORT TERM FORECAST

---
# Advice Basis

- For 2025, the EU Commission requested ICES to provide advice based on the MSY approach

  - Since $B1+_{2025}$ > $B_{pa}$ then $F_{2025}$ = $F_{MSY}$ = 0.092

- The precautionary generic HCR should be included in the catch scenario table.

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.dim=c(10,4)}
load("./output/stf/STF_pil27.8c9a.RData")

biomass <- seq(0,600000, by = 1000)

#Specify the biomass and fishing mortality trigger points of the HCR
Bloss <- 112943
Flow <- 0.064
Ftarget <- 0.12
Bmsy <- 252523
Bpa <- 446331

Brefs <- c(Bloss,Bmsy,Bpa)


b.pos <- findInterval(biomass, Brefs)
Ftg   <- ifelse(b.pos==0,0,ifelse(b.pos == 1,(0-Flow)*Bloss/(Bmsy-Bloss) + (Flow/(Bmsy-Bloss))*biomass,
                                  ifelse(b.pos == 2,(Flow-(Ftarget-Flow)*Bmsy/(Bpa-Bmsy)) + ((Ftarget-Flow)/(Bpa-Bmsy))*biomass,Ftarget)))

data.frame(biomass = biomass, F = Ftg)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=biomass, y = F))+
  geom_line()+
  geom_vline(xintercept = round(stf_final[1,4],0),linetype="dashed")+
  annotate("text", x = round(stf_final[1,4],0), y = 0, label = "B1+ in interim year + 1")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = round(stf_final[length(stf_final$F)-3,5],4),linetype="dashed")+
  annotate("text", y = round(stf_final[length(stf_final$F)-3,5],4)+0.005, x = 1.0e+5, label = "F in interim year + 1")

```

---
# Basis for the catch scenarios

- $F_{2024}$ = `r round(fbar(pil.stock_stf[,ac(ass.yr)]),3)` corresponding to `r as.character(round(catch(pil.stock_stf)[,ac(2024)],0))`
- $B1+_{2024}$ = `r as.character(round(as.numeric(biomass(pil.stock_stf[,ac(ass.yr)])),0))` and $B1+_{2025}$ = `r as.character(round(stf_final[1,4],0))`
